profile_text.body:
Cognigy, headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, operates under the combined brand NiCE Cognigy and describes itself as powering enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat channels. The company positions its platform as a tool for contact centers, enabling businesses to deploy AI agents intended to deliver fast and personalized customer service.

The company's primary tracked product is the Cognigy conversational AI platform, categorized as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration solution. The platform is noted as GDPR-compliant with EU-hosted deployment options available, which the site presents as relevant for organizations with data residency requirements.

The held facts record twelve Delaware legal exposure entries associated with Cognigy, suggesting a meaningful litigation or registration footprint in that jurisdiction, though no specific case details are provided. The company maintains a verified profile on theworldofai.org as of August 2026.
